title: Putnami verdict policy
description: What each verdict gap and each declaration change costs a change. A repository places a putnami.verdict-policy.json at its root, in a scope directory or in a project directory. The nearest file that names a key decides; inside that key, the maturity of the feature concerned can pick the value. The policy decides what blocks a change; it never changes the verdict. The Go validator also checks what this schema does not state: unknown-impact and unknown-declarations are set only in the root file.

declarations.description: When a change to a declaration of each kind waits for an approval. A change to a verdict policy always waits: no policy sets the policy kind.

gaps.description: What a gap of each kind costs a change. lost-proof is an unproven requirement that the change's base proved.

approval.description: always: every change waits for an approval. when-weakening: a change that weakens the declaration waits; one the producer could not judge counts as weakening. never: no change waits.

oneOf.description: From each maturity on, for the highest maturity of the features the declaration declares.

cost.description: inform: listed, never blocks. accept: blocks until a person accepts it. block: blocks, and nobody can accept it.

oneOf.description: From each maturity on, for the maturity of the feature the requirement belongs to.
